paper_title: New constraints on axion-like dark matter using a Floquet quantum detector
notes: This paper (arXiv:2105.04603, Sci. Adv. 8, eabl8919, published Feb 2022) reports new constraints from the NASDUCK Floquet quantum detector on ALP-neutron and ALP-proton interactions. However, the main results constrain quadratic-type couplings (Eq. 2-3: g_DM = ε_N g²_NNN-Quad and pseudoscalar DM quadratic coupling), not the canonical linear pseudoscalar coupling defined for AxionNeutron (L = (g_an/2m_n)∂_μ a n̄ γ^μ γ_5 n). The mass range is 4×10^-15 to 4×10^-11 eV. Model-dependent proton coupling bounds are also presented (Fig. S6-S7). Since the paper constrains non-canonical quadratic interactions rather than the canonical linear couplings listed in the compilation, this is not reportable as a new limit on the canonical coupling types, though it represents genuine new experimental constraints on alternative ALP coupling models. Precise tabulated bounds are available in the NASDUCK repository: https://github.com/ItayBM/NASDUCKFloquet
